cardiac_conduction.label: Cardiac conduction
cardiac_conduction.plain: The electrical pathway that coordinates the heartbeat.

av_block.label: Atrioventricular (AV) block
av_block.plain: Electrical impulses from the atria are delayed or fail to reach the ventricles.

tavr.label: TAVR
tavr.plain: Transcatheter aortic valve replacement: placing a new aortic valve through a catheter.

bradycardia.label: Bradycardia
bradycardia.plain: A slower-than-usual heart rate; clinical significance depends on symptoms and perfusion.

perfusion.label: Perfusion
perfusion.plain: Blood flow through tissues that delivers oxygen and nutrients.

cardiac_output.label: Cardiac output
cardiac_output.plain: The amount of blood the heart pumps per minute; heart rate multiplied by stroke volume.

mechanical_capture.label: Mechanical capture
mechanical_capture.plain: A pacing impulse results in an effective heartbeat that produces circulation.
